status: draft, fixed before any plumbing fit; the runs start once 200129 and 205528 are admitted
reads: dev only: no validation take exists, and none is read. The test split stays sealed; 053616 is never read

vocabulary.simple_swing: Caps Lock = Simple Swing (James's decision 2026-09-23): the 15th action, bound to key:58:0, trained and scored with its positives (13 presses in 200129, where VK 20 is first seen). Never sent: its pad control does not exist until the pilot pad profile binds Simple Swing to a button and Live.ALLOWED includes it (lane doc, Pilot pre-registration item 7)
vocabulary.step_tables: every step table is written by intake with these 15 actions; the 14-action tables of 051828 and 171533 are superseded and re-emitted, and their caches are rebuilt (the cache binds the step table's sha256)

cohort.dev_rule: dev = 171533 plus the later-recorded of the two new sessions (205528, recorded after 200129), fixed here before either is admitted. The rule does not look at content; it also keeps 200129's 13 simple_swing presses in train
cohort.split_required: every recording's header split is 'train' (dev recordings are train-split recordings held out of fitting); a val or test recording is refused
cohort.frozen: the dev list stays the same between the plumbing and the real fit (runbook step 5)

fixed.sealed_denylist: data/human/sealed-denylist.json at its pinned sha256 (the package default)
fixed.hud_parity: not passed: plumbing does not choose a candidate
fixed.code: a git archive of the landed commit that carries this file, on the Mac outside every checkout

runs.name: plumb-p1-curve
runs.purpose: the dev curve: per-epoch dev loss for every arm at weight decay 1e-4

runs.name: plumb-p2-repeat
runs.purpose: MPS repeatability on real data at plumbing scale: its checkpoints must be byte-identical to p1's of the same name

runs.name: plumb-p3-wd
runs.purpose: the weight-decay alternative, on the pre-registered candidate arm

runs.name: plumb-p5-scale-{fraction}
runs.purpose: the scaling curve: nested time-prefixes of each train recording, fixed optimiser steps
runs.max_steps: 10 full epochs of the whole train set at stride 48: 10 x ceil(windows / 8), computed from the admitted step tables by range_bc_plumbing.py and printed with the commands

derivation.arm: model_nohud, the pre-registered candidate (round 3). The HUD arm's curve is reported beside it and selects nothing
derivation.weight_decay: 0.001 if the minimum over epochs of p3's model_nohud seed-0 dev total loss is strictly lower than p1's; otherwise 0.0001
derivation.epochs: E* = 1 + the argmin epoch of the chosen weight decay's model_nohud seed-0 dev total loss (ties go to fewer epochs)
derivation.stride: 48 if E* <= 10, else 64 (the lead's first fallback: every step scored once, -25% cost)
derivation.lag: 0 until the frame-to-send latency is measured; the lag runs are reported, not used
derivation.hud_parity_sha256: the sha256 of the parity file passed to derive: a P2' result if one exists by then, else run 1 (hud-parity-1.json, 158649e6...), which keeps the no-HUD candidate
refuse_if: p1 and p2 checkpoints of the same name differ (the reproduction rule needs byte repeatability)
any plumbing report is missing, is not scope plumbing, read a val or test recording, or used a different cohort or step-table sha256
a run's arguments differ from this file

plotted_against_dev: frames-minus-twin gap in teacher-forced macro press-F1 on the [t-1, t] window (model_nohud minus history_only, mean of seeds 0 and 1)
scaling_reading.a: the frames-minus-twin gap is not positive and rising from 1/2 to all: more minutes will not make the policy use its eyes; change the observation or encoder first
scaling_reading.b: dev NLL falls roughly linearly in log(minutes): extrapolate to 2.5 h of train; if the projection does not clear the G2/G3 floors with margin, 3 h is not enough, and the report states the implied minutes
scaling_reading.c: train NLL falls while dev NLL rises: the model is memorising; fix regularisation before adding data
scaling_reading.minutes: each point reports its actual counted train minutes, not only the fraction

budget: estimated by range_bc_plumbing.py from the admitted step tables and the smoke's measured throughput (HUD arm 802 frames/s, no-HUD 1,056, twin 52k; 22 s of evaluation per 4,800 dev rows); printed with the commands. One niced durable queue on the Mac
